newsitem.title: USA: Dress Barn stake raised by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Dress Barn stake raised by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik on Tuesday it raised its stake in Dress Barn Inc to 1,886,400 common shares, or 8.3 percent, from 7.3 percent held previously.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included the purchase of 236,900 common shares between January 17 and January 27 at prices ranging from $15.665 to $16.3750 each.
Dress Barn, based in Stamford, Conn., is engaged in the operation of women's apparel stores.
